# Find All Duplicates in an Array

## Problem

You are given an integer array `nums` with `n` elements. Every value satisfies $$1 \le nums[i] \le n$$, and each distinct integer in the array occurs either a single time or exactly two times. Return all of the integers that occur twice.

Your solution must meet these requirements:

- It runs in $$O(n)$$ time.
- It uses only $$O(1)$$ additional space, not counting the list that is returned.
- It is allowed to change the contents of `nums`.
- The integers in the result can appear in any order.

When run against standard input, the first line holds `n` and the second line holds the `n` array values separated by spaces; print the duplicated integers on one line separated by spaces.

Example 1:

```text
Input: nums = [4,3,2,7,8,2,3,1]

Output: [2,3]
```

Explanation: The values `2` and `3` each occur two times, while every other value occurs once.

Example 2:

```text
Input: nums = [1,1,2]

Output: [1]
```

Example 3:

```text
Input:
8
4 3 2 7 8 2 3 1

Output: 2 3
```

Constraints:

* $$1 \le n \le 100000$$
* $$1 \le nums[i] \le n$$
* Each integer appears at most twice.

## Hints

<details>
<summary>Hint 1</summary>

Since values lie in 1..n, each value can be treated as an index into the array itself.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Hint 2</summary>

Use the sign of nums[abs(v)-1] as an in-place visited marker, flipping it the first time you see v.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Hint 3</summary>

If the slot is already negative when you meet v, then v is a duplicate, this gives O(n) time and O(1) extra space.

</details>
